tasks.topic: Compare horizontal-versus-vertical permeability contrast in two different handbook well-test worked examples: the early-radial horizontal-well case with kx and kz, and Example 8.4 Well Prf-3 with kx and kz. No permeability numbers are supplied by the user.
tasks.goal: Extract the actual permeability numbers for both examples, use the separate RFT definition A=kh/kv to calculate both anisotropy ratios and their ratio, and avoid treating the examples as the same reservoir or predicting RFT drawdown from A alone.

success_criteria.description: Retrieve four KB permeability values from the two actual examples.
Cite A=kh/kv and compute A for each example plus contrast.
Do not conflate the two reservoirs or equate A with RFT drawdown directly.
